      <div><br>
      </div>
      <div style="text-align: center;">MASTER SERVICES AGREEMENT</div>
      <div><br>
      </div>
      <div style="text-align: center;">by and between</div>
      <div><br>
      </div>
      <div style="text-align: center;">KBR, INC.</div>
      <div><br>
      </div>
      <div style="text-align: center;">and</div>
      <div><br>
      </div>
      <div style="text-align: center;">TRINZIC, INC.</div>
      <div><br>
      </div>
      <div style="text-align: center;">Dated as of [&#9679;], 20[&#9679;]</div>
      <div style="clear: both; margin-top: 10pt; margin-bottom: 10pt;" class="BRPFPageBreakArea">
        <div style="page-break-after: always;" class="BRPFPageBreak">
          <hr style="margin: 4px 0px; width: 100%; border-width: 0; height: 2px; color: #000000; background-color: #000000; clear: both;" noshade="noshade"></div>
      </div>
      <div><br>
      </div>
      <div style="text-align: justify; text-indent: 72pt;">This MASTER SERVICES AGREEMENT (this &#8220;<u>Agreement</u>&#8221;), dated as of [&#9679;], 20[&#9679;] (the &#8220;<u>Effective Date</u>&#8221;), is entered into by and between KBR, Inc., a Delaware corporation (&#8220;<u>KBR</u>&#8221;), and
        Trinzic, Inc., a Delaware corporation (&#8220;<u>Supplier</u>&#8221;). &#8220;<u>Party</u>&#8221; or &#8220;<u>Parties</u>&#8221; means Supplier or SpinCo, individually or collectively, as the case may be.</div>
      <div><br>
      </div>
      <div style="text-align: center;"><u>W I T N E S S E T H:</u></div>
      <div><br>
      </div>
      <div style="text-align: justify; text-indent: 72pt;">WHEREAS, the Parties have entered into that certain Separation and Distribution Agreement, dated as of the date hereof (the &#8220;<u>Separation Agreement</u>&#8221;) and associated Transition Services
        Agreement, dated as of the date hereof (the &#8220;<u>Transition Services Agreement</u>&#8221;) to govern the provision and receipt of certain services provided or facilitated by each Party to the other Party and its Affiliates after the Distribution Date;</div>
      <div><br>
      </div>
      <div style="text-align: justify; text-indent: 72pt;">WHEREAS, certain other services that are not included under the Transition Services Agreement will be provided or facilitated by Supplier to or for the benefit of the KBR Group pursuant to this
        Master Services Agreement on the terms and conditions set forth herein; and</div>
      <div><br>
      </div>
      <div style="text-align: justify; text-indent: 72pt;">WHEREAS, the Parties acknowledge that this Agreement, the Separation Agreement, and the other Ancillary Agreements represent the integrated agreement of Supplier and KBR relating to the separation
        and distribution transactions contemplated in the Separation Agreement, are being entered into together, and would not have been entered into independently.</div>
      <div><br>
      </div>
      <div style="text-align: justify; text-indent: 72pt;">NOW, THEREFORE, in consideration of the foregoing and the mutual agreements, provisions and covenants contained in this Agreement, the Parties hereby agree as follows:</div>
      <div><br>
      </div>
      <div style="text-align: center; font-weight: bold;">ARTICLE I</div>
      <div><br>
      </div>
      <div style="text-align: center; font-weight: bold;"><u>DEFINITIONS</u></div>
      <div><br>
      </div>
      <div style="text-align: justify; text-indent: 72pt;">Section 1.01</div>
      <div style="margin: -12pt 0px 0px; text-align: justify; text-indent: 144pt;"><u>Certain Defined Terms</u>.&#8239;&#8239;Unless otherwise defined herein, all capitalized terms used herein shall have the same meanings as in the Separation Agreement.&#8239;The following
        capitalized terms used in this Agreement shall have the meanings set forth below:</div>
      <div><br>
      </div>
      <div style="text-align: justify; text-indent: 72pt;">&#8220;<u>Information Technology Systems</u>&#8221; means computers, computer systems, workstations, tablets, mobile devices, phones, blades, servers, peripheral devices, software, applications, programs,
        hardware, databases, circuits, networks, routers, hubs, switches, interfaces, websites, platforms, automated networks and control systems, and all other information technology systems, including outsourced or cloud computing arrangements.</div>
      <div><br>
      </div>
      <div style="text-align: justify; text-indent: 72pt;">&#8220;<u>Party Data</u>&#8221; means Supplier Data or Recipient Data, as the context requires.</div>
      <div><br>
      </div>
      <div style="text-align: justify; text-indent: 72pt;">&#8220;<u>Recipient</u>&#8221; means KBR or any Affiliate or member of the KBR Group, as applicable, to which a Service is being provided under this Agreement.</div>
      <div><br>
      </div>
      <div style="text-align: justify; text-indent: 72pt;">&#8220;<u>Recipient Data</u>&#8221; means data or information, including Personal Data, that as between the Parties, is owned or controlled by a Recipient and to which a Supplier Party may have access under
        this Agreement.</div>
      <div><br>
      </div>
      <div style="clear: both; margin-top: 10pt; margin-bottom: 10pt;" class="BRPFPageBreakArea">
        <div style="page-break-after: always;" class="BRPFPageBreak">
          <hr style="margin: 4px 0px; width: 100%; border-width: 0; height: 2px; color: #000000; background-color: #000000; clear: both;" noshade="noshade"></div>
      </div>
      <!--PROfilePageNumberReset%Num%2%%%-->
      <div><br>
      </div>
      <div style="text-align: justify; text-indent: 72pt;">&#8220;<u>Service Affiliate</u>&#8221; means an Affiliate of Supplier involved in the provision of the Services.</div>
      <div><br>
      </div>
      <div style="text-align: justify; text-indent: 72pt;">&#8220;<u>Service Charge</u>&#8221; means, with respect to each Service, the amounts payable to a Supplier Party set forth in the applicable Statement of Work.</div>
      <div><br>
      </div>
      <div style="text-align: justify; text-indent: 72pt;">&#8220;<u>Statement of Work</u>&#8221; means any statement of work, service schedule or other similar document executed by the Parties that references this Agreement and sets forth the Services to be provided
        by a Supplier Party pursuant to this Agreement and any additional terms and conditions applicable thereto. The initial Statement of Work is attached to this Agreement as Schedule <u>2.01-1</u>.</div>
      <div><br>
      </div>
      <div style="text-align: justify; text-indent: 72pt;">&#8220;<u>Supplier Data</u>&#8221; means data or information, including Personal Data, that as between the Parties, is owned or controlled by a Supplier Party and to which a Recipient may have access under
        this Agreement.</div>
      <div><br>
      </div>
      <div style="text-align: justify; text-indent: 72pt;">&#8220;<u>Supplier Party</u>&#8221; means Supplier, any Service Affiliate, Affiliate of any such Service Affiliate or Third Party Provider, as applicable, that is providing a Service under this Agreement.</div>
      <div><br>
      </div>
      <div style="text-align: justify; text-indent: 72pt;">&#8220;<u>Virus(es)</u>&#8221; means any computer instructions: (a)&#8239;that have a material adverse effect on the operation, security or integrity of a computing telecommunications or other digital operating or
        processing system or environment, including other programs, data, databases, computer libraries and computer and communications equipment, by altering, destroying, disrupting or inhibiting such operation, security or integrity; (b)&#8239;that without
        functional purpose, self-replicate without manual intervention; or (c)&#8239;that purport to perform a useful function but which actually either perform a destructive or harmful function, or perform no useful function and utilize substantial computer,
        telecommunications or memory resources.</div>
      <div><br>
      </div>
      <div style="text-align: justify; text-indent: 72pt;">Section 1.02</div>
      <div style="margin: -12pt 0px 0px; text-align: justify; text-indent: 144pt;"><u>Other Defined Terms</u>.</div>

      <div><br>
      </div>
      <div style="text-align: center; font-weight: bold;">ARTICLE II</div>
      <div><br>
      </div>
      <div style="text-align: center; font-weight: bold;"><u>SERVICES, ACCESS TO FACILITIES AND DURATION</u></div>
      <div><br>
      </div>
      <div style="text-align: justify; text-indent: 72pt;">Section 2.01</div>
      <div style="margin: -12pt 0px 0px; text-align: justify; text-indent: 144pt;"><u>Services</u>.</div>
      <div><br>
      </div>
      <div style="text-align: justify; text-indent: 108pt;">(a)</div>
      <div style="margin: -12pt 0px 0px; text-align: justify; text-indent: 144pt;">Subject to the terms and conditions of this Agreement, Supplier shall provide (or cause to be provided) to the KBR Group the services set forth in each Statement of Work
        (collectively, the &#8220;<u>Services</u>&#8221;) in accordance with terms of such Statement of Work and for the duration thereof (each, a &#8220;<u>Service Term</u>&#8221;). Upon execution, each Statement of Work shall be deemed to be incorporated into and form part of
        this Agreement.</div>
      <div><br>
      </div>
      <div style="text-align: justify; text-indent: 108pt;">(b)</div>
      <div style="margin: -12pt 0px 0px; text-align: justify; text-indent: 144pt;">KBR acknowledges and agrees that no services other than those set forth in a Statement of Work will be provided by or on behalf of any Supplier Party. Each Party
        acknowledges and agrees that access to and use of the Services is provided solely for the use and benefit of KBR and the applicable Recipient and their respective Affiliates during the Term. Except as permitted by <u>Section 9.06</u>, KBR shall
        not allow access to or use of the Services by (and the Supplier Parties shall have no obligation to provide any services to) any other Person or for any other purpose without the prior written consent of Supplier.</div>
      <div><br>
      </div>
      <div style="text-align: justify; text-indent: 72pt;">Section 2.02</div>
      <div style="margin: -12pt 0px 0px; text-align: justify; text-indent: 144pt;"><u>Access to Facilities</u>. Subject to the terms and conditions of this Agreement, the Services may include, and Supplier shall provide (or cause to be provided) to the KBR
        Group, access to facilities, equipment (including Information Technology Systems) and software (collectively, &#8220;<u>Facilities</u>&#8221;), in each case as set forth in the applicable Statement of Work. Such access to Facilities will be deemed part of the
        relevant Services for purposes of this Agreement.</div>
      <div><br>
      </div>
      <div style="text-align: justify; text-indent: 72pt;">Section 2.03</div>
      <div style="margin: -12pt 0px 0px; text-align: justify; text-indent: 144pt;"><u>Term</u>. The effectiveness of this Agreement shall begin on the Effective Date and continue until the earlier of: (i) the date on which there are no active Statements of
        Work; and (ii) the date upon which this Agreement has been terminated with respect to all Services in accordance with <u>Section 7.01</u> (the &#8220;<u>Term</u>&#8221;).</div>
      <div><br>
      </div>
      <div style="clear: both; margin-top: 10pt; margin-bottom: 10pt;" class="BRPFPageBreakArea">
        <div class="BRPFPageNumberArea" style="text-align: center;"><font class="BRPFPageNumber" style="font-weight: normal; font-style: normal;">3</font></div>
        <div style="page-break-after: always;" class="BRPFPageBreak">
          <hr style="margin: 4px 0px; width: 100%; border-width: 0; height: 2px; color: #000000; background-color: #000000; clear: both;" noshade="noshade"></div>
      </div>
      <div><br>
      </div>
      <div style="text-align: justify; text-indent: 72pt;">Section 2.04</div>
      <div style="margin: -12pt 0px 0px; text-align: justify; text-indent: 144pt;"><u>Additional Services; Changes</u>.</div>
      <div><br>
      </div>
      <div style="text-align: justify; text-indent: 108pt;">(a)</div>
      <div style="margin: -12pt 0px 0px; text-align: justify; text-indent: 144pt;"><u>Additional Services</u>. From time to time during the Term, KBR may request that Supplier provide (or cause to be provided) additional service in addition to the Services
        that are outside the scope of a change to any then-applicable Statement of Work in accordance with <u>Section 2.07</u> (such services, &#8220;<u>Additional Services</u>&#8221;). The Parties shall discuss any such request in good faith and Supplier may, in its
        discretion, provide KBR with a written proposal in respect of such Additional Service, which proposal shall include: (a) a description of the services, functions and responsibilities Supplier anticipates performing in connection with such
        Additional Service; (b) a description of any additional obligations of KBR required for the applicable Supplier Party to perform such Additional Service; (c) the prospective fees applicable to such Additional Service, including a detailed breakdown
        of such fees; and (d) any other information reasonably necessary for the Parties to evaluate the feasibility of Supplier providing (or causing to be provided) such Additional Service. Supplier shall have no obligation to provide (or cause to be
        provided) any Additional Service unless and until the Parties have entered into a Statement of Work for such Additional Service. If Supplier agrees to provide an Additional Service, upon the Parties&#8217; execution of a new Statement of Work or written
        amendment to an applicable Statement of Work, any such Additional Service shall be deemed part of the Services hereunder.</div>
      <div><br>
      </div>
      <div style="text-align: justify; text-indent: 72pt;">Section 2.05</div>
      <div style="margin: -12pt 0px 0px; text-align: justify; text-indent: 144pt;"><u>Exception to Obligation to Provide Services</u>.&#8239;Notwithstanding anything in this Agreement to the contrary, including Supplier&#8217;s and KBR&#8217;s obligations set forth in <u>Section
          2.01</u> hereof:</div>
      <div><br>
      </div>
      <div style="text-align: justify; text-indent: 108pt;">(a)</div>
      <div style="margin: -12pt 0px 0px; text-align: justify; text-indent: 144pt;">Supplier shall not be obligated to (and Supplier shall not be obligated to cause any Supplier Party to) provide any Services if the provision of such Services would violate
        any Law or any Contract to which Supplier, any Affiliate of Supplier or any of Supplier Parties are subject; <font style="font-style: italic;"><u>provided</u>, <u>however</u></font>, that Supplier and KBR shall comply with <u>Section 8.02</u> in
        obtaining any Required Consents; and</div>
      <div><br>
      </div>
      <div style="text-align: justify; text-indent: 108pt;">(b)</div>
      <div style="margin: -12pt 0px 0px; text-align: justify; text-indent: 144pt;">Supplier and any Service Affiliate shall have the right in their sole discretion to determine that it is necessary or appropriate to temporarily suspend a Service due to
        scheduled or emergency maintenance, modification, repairs, updates or upgrades, alterations or replacements of any of systems or operations which are required to provide Services (a &#8220;<u>Shutdown</u>&#8221;). Supplier will or will cause the applicable
        Service Affiliate to use commercially reasonable efforts to provide the Recipient with reasonable written notice of such Shutdowns as soon as reasonably practicable. If any Services are suspended in accordance with this Section 2.05(b): (i)
        Supplier and any applicable Service Affiliate shall have no liability whatsoever to KBR or any Recipient directly arising out of or relating to such suspension; and (ii) any payment of Service Charges for suspended Services is suspended as well.
        Notwithstanding the foregoing in this Section 2.05(b), if a Shutdown continues materially longer than anticipated, the Parties will discuss in good faith a commercially reasonable mitigation or solution for the Shutdown.</div>
      <div><br>
      </div>
      <div style="text-align: justify; text-indent: 108pt;">(c)</div>
      <div style="margin: -12pt 0px 0px; text-align: justify; text-indent: 144pt;">For Services that relate to the hosting, maintenance and other support of conveyed applications, Supplier&#8217;s or the applicable Service Affiliate&#8217;s obligation is to solely
        continue such support in the environment as it existed prior to the Effective Date, and the obligation of Supplier or such Service Affiliate to provide the associated Service for a conveyed application is terminated if the Recipient moves the
        application to a different environment or makes modifications that impact the Services for that application.</div>
      <div><br>
      </div>
      <div style="clear: both; margin-top: 10pt; margin-bottom: 10pt;" class="BRPFPageBreakArea">

      <div style="text-align: justify; text-indent: 72pt;">Section 2.06</div>
      <div style="margin: -12pt 0px 0px; text-align: justify; text-indent: 144pt;"><u>Standard of the Provision of Services</u>.</div>
      <div><br>
      </div>
      <div style="text-align: justify; text-indent: 108pt;">(a)</div>
      <div style="margin: -12pt 0px 0px; text-align: justify; text-indent: 144pt;">Except as otherwise set forth in an applicable Statement of Work, the Services shall be provided in accordance with, and subject to, Supplier&#8217;s and each Service Affiliate&#8217;s
        policies and procedures that are applicable at the time the Services are provided and in the manner and at a level substantially consistent with that provided by Supplier and the Service Affiliates immediately preceding the Distribution Date. All
        of the Services and Facilities shall be for the sole use and benefit of the KBR Group; <font style="font-style: italic;"><u>provided</u></font> that nothing in this <u>Section 2.06 </u>is intended to limit Supplier&#8217;s or a Service Affiliate&#8217;s
        access to or use of its own Facilities except as may be set forth in the applicable Statement of Work.</div>
      <div><br>
      </div>
      <div style="text-align: justify; text-indent: 72pt;">Section 2.07</div>
      <div style="margin: -12pt 0px 0px; text-align: justify; text-indent: 144pt;"><u>Changes</u>. Supplier and Service Affiliates may from time to time reasonably supplement, modify, substitute or otherwise alter the Services provided in a manner that
        does not materially adversely affect the quality or availability of Services or increase the cost of using such Services. A Party&#8217;s request for modification to the scope of Services or any request for another change to a Statement of Work pursuant
        to <u>Section 2.07</u> shall be in writing and shall specify the type and scope of the requested service or the requested change. The other Party shall promptly respond in writing to such request and the Parties shall thereafter each use
        commercially reasonable efforts to reach agreement to the change.</div>
      <div><br>
      </div>
      <div style="text-align: justify; text-indent: 72pt;">Section 2.08</div>
      <div style="margin: -12pt 0px 0px; text-align: justify; text-indent: 144pt;"><u>Subcontractors</u>.</div>
      <div><br>
      </div>
      <div style="text-align: justify; text-indent: 108pt;">(a)</div>
      <div style="margin: -12pt 0px 0px; text-align: justify; text-indent: 144pt;">Supplier and any Service Affiliate may subcontract any of the Services or portion thereof to any other Person (any such Person, a &#8220;<u>Third Party Provider</u>&#8221;) or any other
        Service Affiliate. Where this Agreement imposes obligations on Supplier or any Supplier Party, Supplier shall cause and compel each Service Affiliate or, as applicable, direct each Third Party Provider to perform such obligations and comply with
        the terms of this Agreement, provided, that, subject to <u>Section 2.08(b)</u>, Supplier shall remain responsible for such Supplier Party&#8217;s compliance with the terms of this Agreement.</div>
      <div><br>
      </div>
      <div style="text-align: justify; text-indent: 108pt;">(b)</div>
      <div style="margin: -12pt 0px 0px; text-align: justify; text-indent: 144pt;">Notwithstanding <u>Section 2.08(a)</u>, if and to the extent that Supplier&#8217;s or a Service Affiliate&#8217;s failure to perform its obligations under this Agreement or any breach
        of this Agreement is caused by the act or omission of a Third Party Provider used by Supplier or such Service Affiliate for the provision of Services, Supplier or the applicable Service Affiliate shall not be responsible, liable or otherwise
        considered as being in breach of this Agreement, provided that Supplier or such Service Affiliate shall use its commercially reasonable efforts to exercise and enforce its contractual rights and seek to claim any available contractual remedies in
        respect of the relevant act or omission of the Third Party Provider, and pass-on to the Recipient an equitable and proportionate share of the Indemnifiable Losses or similar amounts. Alternatively, Supplier or the applicable Service Affiliate may,
        in its sole discretion, assign to the Recipient any claims that it may assert against the relevant Third Party Provider in relation to Recipient&#8217;s Indemnifiable Losses. In case the act or omission of the Third Party Provider that caused the
        Indemnifiable Loss also caused prejudice to Supplier or the applicable Service Affiliate&#8217;s own business (or that of its Affiliates), the distribution of any Indemnifiable Losses recovered by Supplier to Recipient shall be limited to a reasonable
        pro rata share of such Indemnifiable Losses.</div>

      <div style="text-align: justify; text-indent: 72pt;">Section 2.09</div>
      <div style="margin: -12pt 0px 0px; text-align: justify; text-indent: 144pt;"><u>Access to Information Technology Systems</u>.</div>
      <div><br>
      </div>
      <div style="text-align: justify; text-indent: 108pt;">(a)</div>
      <div style="margin: -12pt 0px 0px; text-align: justify; text-indent: 144pt;">To the extent that the performance or receipt of Services hereunder requires access to the Information Technology Systems of Supplier or a Service Affiliate by the Recipient
        (the &#8220;<u>Accessing Party</u>&#8221;), Supplier or the Service Affiliate whose Information Technology Systems are being accessed (the &#8220;<u>Granting Party</u>&#8221;) shall provide or cause to be provided limited access to such Information Technology Systems,
        subject to policies, procedures and limitations to be determined by the Granting Party.</div>
      <div><br>
      </div>
      <div style="text-align: justify; text-indent: 108pt;">(b)</div>
      <div style="margin: -12pt 0px 0px; text-align: justify; text-indent: 144pt;">Each Accessing Party shall cause any of its personnel who require such access to:</div>
      <div><br>
      </div>
      <div style="text-align: justify; text-indent: 108pt; margin-left: 36pt;">(i)</div>
      <div style="margin: -12pt 0px 0px 36pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 144pt;">comply with all security guidelines (including physical security, network access, internet security, confidentiality and Personal Data security guidelines) of the other
        Party (collectively, &#8220;<u>InfoSec Policies</u>&#8221;), copies of which shall be made available to the Accessing Party upon reasonable request, and in accordance with applicable Law;</div>
      <div><br>
      </div>
      <div style="text-align: justify; text-indent: 108pt; margin-left: 36pt;">(ii)</div>
      <div style="margin: -12pt 0px 0px 36pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 144pt;">limit such access solely to the use of such Information Technology Systems and Party Data for purposes of the Services and not access or attempt to access Information
        Technology Systems other than those required for the Services;</div>
      <div><br>
      </div>
      <div style="text-align: justify; text-indent: 108pt; margin-left: 36pt;">(iii)</div>
      <div style="margin: -12pt 0px 0px 36pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 144pt;">comply with all applicable rules, policies and procedures of the Granting Party;</div>
      <div><br>
      </div>
      <div style="text-align: justify; text-indent: 108pt; margin-left: 36pt;">(iv)</div>
      <div style="margin: -12pt 0px 0px 36pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 144pt;">not make any changes to the Granting Party&#8217;s Information Technology Systems or Party Data that may be reasonably expected to have an adverse effect on such Information
        Technology Systems or Party Data or the provision of the Services;</div>
      <div><br>
      </div>
      <div style="text-align: justify; text-indent: 108pt; margin-left: 36pt;">(v)</div>
      <div style="margin: -12pt 0px 0px 36pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 144pt;">not extract or share any data from the Granting Party&#8217;s Information Technology Systems other than as required to perform or use the Services or comply with applicable
        Law, or as expressly permitted by the terms of the relevant Service as set out in the applicable schedule or any other transaction document;</div>
      <div><br>
      </div>
      <div style="text-align: justify; text-indent: 108pt; margin-left: 36pt;">(vi)</div>
      <div style="margin: -12pt 0px 0px 36pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 144pt;">promptly notify the Granting Party: (A) of any vulnerabilities in the Accessing Party&#8217;s assets that are connected to the Granting Party&#8217;s Information Technology
        Systems; and (B) upon becoming aware of any vulnerability related to the Services or Information Technology Systems utilized in the provision or use of the Services; and</div>
      <div><br>
      </div>
      <div style="text-align: justify; text-indent: 108pt; margin-left: 36pt;">(vii)</div>
      <div style="margin: -12pt 0px 0px 36pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 144pt;">promptly terminate access to the Granting Party&#8217;s Information Technology Systems and notify the Granting Party if an employee, supplier, or contractor no longer needs
        access to the Granting Party&#8217;s Information Technology Systems or is no longer employed or engaged by the Granting Party.</div>
      <div><br>
      </div>
      <div style="clear: both; margin-top: 10pt; margin-bottom: 10pt;" class="BRPFPageBreakArea">
        <div class="BRPFPageNumberArea" style="text-align: center;"><font class="BRPFPageNumber" style="font-weight: normal; font-style: normal;">6</font></div>
        <div style="page-break-after: always;" class="BRPFPageBreak">
          <hr style="margin: 4px 0px; width: 100%; border-width: 0; height: 2px; color: #000000; background-color: #000000; clear: both;" noshade="noshade"></div>
      </div>
      <div><br>
      </div>
      <div style="text-align: justify; text-indent: 108pt;">(c)</div>
      <div style="margin: -12pt 0px 0px; text-align: justify; text-indent: 144pt;">The Accessing Party shall limit such access to the Information Technology Systems and Party Data to:</div>
      <div><br>
      </div>
      <div style="text-align: justify; text-indent: 108pt; margin-left: 36pt;">(i)</div>
      <div style="margin: -12pt 0px 0px 36pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 144pt;">only employees and contractors who had access to such Information Technology Systems and Party Data immediately prior to the Effective Date; and</div>
      <div><br>
      </div>
      <div style="text-align: justify; text-indent: 108pt; margin-left: 36pt;">(ii)</div>
      <div style="margin: -12pt 0px 0px 36pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 144pt;">its or its Affiliates&#8217; other employees and contractors with a bona fide need to have such access in connection with the Services as requested in writing by the
        Accessing Party and approved in writing by the Granting Party as provided in the relevant schedules. Any employees and contractors of the Accessing Party granted such access shall complete any training required by the Granting Party on the
        permitted and proper access and use of the applicable Information Technology Systems.</div>
      <div><br>
      </div>
      <div style="text-align: justify; text-indent: 108pt;">(d)</div>
      <div style="margin: -12pt 0px 0px; text-align: justify; text-indent: 144pt;">Both the Accessing Party and the Granting Party shall take reasonable steps to monitor and prevent inappropriate use of the Information Technology Systems. The Granting
        Party is permitted to monitor access to its Information Technology Systems and review access logs for the purpose of auditing compliance with the access limitations set forth in this <u>Section 2.09</u>.</div>
      <div><br>
      </div>
      <div style="text-align: justify; text-indent: 108pt;">(e)</div>
      <div style="margin: -12pt 0px 0px; text-align: justify; text-indent: 144pt;">The Accessing Party will promptly notify the Granting Party of the termination of any of its or its Group members&#8217; employees or contractors with a user identification number
        for the Information Technology Systems and inform each such terminated employee or contractor that their access to and use of Information Technology Systems has been revoked. All user identification numbers and passwords disclosed pursuant to this
        Agreement and any information obtained by the Accessing Party&#8217;s Group as a result of any Accessing Party&#8217;s access to and use of the Granting Party&#8217;s Information Technology Systems shall be deemed to be, and treated as, Confidential Information
        hereunder. The Accessing Party&#8217;s and its Affiliates&#8217; employees and contractors shall not share or disclose their user identification numbers and passwords to any other employee or contractor of the Accessing Party or its Affiliates or to any third
        party.</div>
      <div><br>
      </div>
      <div style="text-align: justify; text-indent: 108pt;">(f)</div>
      <div style="margin: -12pt 0px 0px; text-align: justify; text-indent: 144pt;">The Accessing Party is responsible for its and its Affiliates&#8217; employees&#8217; and contractors&#8217; use and misuse of the Granting Party&#8217;s Information Technology Systems and Party
        Data. The Granting Party may revoke the access of the Accessing Party&#8217;s or its Affiliates&#8217; employee or contractor in the event of an actual or reasonably suspected material violation of this Agreement or the Granting Party&#8217;s applicable policies or
        procedures by such employee or contractor, which policies and procedures have been communicated or made available to such employee or contractor before such violation. The Accessing Party shall cooperate with the Granting Party in the investigation
        of any actual or suspected unauthorized access by any of the Accessing Party&#8217;s or its Affiliates&#8217; employees or contractors to any of the Granting Party&#8217;s Information Technology Systems or Party Data.</div>
      <div><br>
      </div>
      <div style="clear: both; margin-top: 10pt; margin-bottom: 10pt;" class="BRPFPageBreakArea">
        <div class="BRPFPageNumberArea" style="text-align: center;"><font class="BRPFPageNumber" style="font-weight: normal; font-style: normal;">7</font></div>
        <div style="page-break-after: always;" class="BRPFPageBreak">
          <hr style="margin: 4px 0px; width: 100%; border-width: 0; height: 2px; color: #000000; background-color: #000000; clear: both;" noshade="noshade"></div>
      </div>
      <div><br>
      </div>
      <div style="text-align: justify; text-indent: 108pt;">(g)</div>
      <div style="margin: -12pt 0px 0px; text-align: justify; text-indent: 144pt;">During the Term, each Party shall take commercially reasonable measures to ensure that no Virus or similar items are coded or introduced into the Information Technology
        Systems of the other Party. With respect to Services provided by third parties, compliance with the applicable agreement with such third party shall be deemed sufficient commercially reasonable measures. If a Virus is found to have been introduced
        into any Information Technology Systems, the Parties shall use commercially reasonable efforts to cooperate and to diligently work together and with Supplier and each Service Affiliate providing the Services to eliminate the effects of the Virus.</div>
      <div><br>
      </div>
      <div style="text-align: justify; text-indent: 108pt;">(h)</div>
      <div style="margin: -12pt 0px 0px; text-align: justify; text-indent: 144pt;">Each Party shall, and shall cause its respective Affiliates to, exercise reasonable care in providing, accessing and using the Services and Information Technology Systems of
        the other Party so as to prevent access to the Services, Facilities, and Information Technology Systems of the other Party by unauthorized Persons.</div>

      <div style="text-align: center; font-weight: bold;">ARTICLE III</div>
      <div><br>
      </div>
      <div style="text-align: center; font-weight: bold;"><u>COSTS AND DISBURSEMENTS</u></div>
      <div><br>
      </div>
      <div style="text-align: justify; text-indent: 72pt;">Section 3.01</div>
      <div style="margin: -12pt 0px 0px; text-align: justify; text-indent: 144pt;"><u>Costs and Disbursements</u>.</div>
      <div><br>
      </div>
      <div style="text-align: justify; text-indent: 108pt;">(a)</div>
      <div style="margin: -12pt 0px 0px; text-align: justify; text-indent: 144pt;">Except as otherwise set forth in a Statement of Work, on a monthly basis in accordance with <u>Section 3.01(b)</u>, Recipient (or its designee) shall pay to Supplier or the
        Service Affiliate providing, or causing to be provided, the applicable Services, those Service Charges associated with the provision of the applicable Services during the prior month.</div>
      <div><br>
      </div>
      <div style="text-align: justify; text-indent: 108pt;">(b)</div>
      <div style="margin: -12pt 0px 0px; text-align: justify; text-indent: 144pt;">As of or promptly following the Effective Date, the Parties shall mutually agree on a form of invoice to be issued for the Service Charges by Supplier. Supplier shall
        invoice KBR (or its designees) for the Service Charges in accordance with the terms of this Agreement and the applicable Statement of Work on a monthly basis (or as otherwise set forth in the applicable Statement of Work), in each case including
        sufficient supporting documentation sufficient for independent audit by KBR&#8217;s independent auditors or as may be required by Governmental Entities with jurisdiction over KBR and for KBR to assess the allowability of the Service Charges under
        applicable Law, but in no event of a nature or in a manner substantially inconsistent with Supplier&#8217;s applicable invoicing practices. KBR (or its designees) shall pay, or cause to be paid, the amount of such invoice by wire transfer or check to
        Supplier (or its designees) within sixty (60) days of the date of such invoice. If KBR or any of its designees, as applicable, fails to pay such amount by such date, KBR shall be obligated to pay to Supplier or the applicable Service Affiliate, in
        addition to the amount due, interest on such amount at a rate per annum equal to the Prime Rate, from time to time in effect, calculated for the actual number of days elapsed, accrued from the date on which such payment was due up to the date of
        the actual receipt of payment.</div>
      <div><br>
      </div>
      <div style="clear: both; margin-top: 10pt; margin-bottom: 10pt;" class="BRPFPageBreakArea">
        <div class="BRPFPageNumberArea" style="text-align: center;"><font class="BRPFPageNumber" style="font-weight: normal; font-style: normal;">8</font></div>
        <div style="page-break-after: always;" class="BRPFPageBreak">

      </div>
      <div><br>
      </div>
      <div style="text-align: justify; text-indent: 72pt;">Section 3.02</div>
      <div style="margin: -12pt 0px 0px; text-align: justify; text-indent: 144pt;"><u>Taxes</u>. Except as expressly noted in the applicable Statement of Work, the fees set forth on the applicable Statement of Work with respect to each Service do not
        include any sales, use, value added, excise, goods and services or similar taxes, charges, fees, levies or imposts (collectively, and together with any interest, penalties or additions to tax imposed with respect thereto, &#8220;<u>Service Taxes</u>&#8221;).
        In addition to the amounts required to be paid as set forth on the applicable Statement of Work or otherwise pursuant to this Agreement, KBR or the applicable Recipient (or its designee) (the &#8220;<u>Applicable Payor</u>&#8221;) shall pay and be responsible
        for and shall promptly reimburse Supplier or the applicable Service Affiliate (or its designee) (the &#8220;<u>Applicable Payee</u>&#8221;) for any Service Taxes imposed on or with respect to such amounts (including by way of withholding or deductions) or the
        provision of Services to the Recipient hereunder, which reimbursement shall be in addition to such amounts and any other amounts required to be paid pursuant to this Agreement. Any and all payments hereunder shall be made free and clear of, and
        without deduction or withholding for or on account of, any Taxes; provided, that if the Applicable Payor is required by applicable Law to deduct or withhold any Taxes from such payments, then: (a)&#8239;the Applicable Payor shall make such deductions or
        withholdings as are required by applicable Law; (b)&#8239;the Applicable Payor shall timely pay the full amount deducted or withheld to the relevant Governmental Entity; and (c)&#8239;to the extent withholding or deduction is required to be made on account of
        Taxes, the amount payable by the Applicable Payor to the Applicable Payee shall be increased as necessary so that after all required deductions and withholdings have been made (including deductions or withholdings applicable to additional sums
        payable hereunder) the Applicable Payee shall receive an amount equal to the sum it would have received had no such deductions or withholdings been made. At the Applicable Payee&#8217;s request, the Applicable Payor shall provide the Applicable Payee
        with reasonably satisfactory documentation evidencing payment to the applicable Governmental Entity of any amounts so withheld or deducted. Supplier shall provide to KBR, prior to the commencement of any Services hereunder, a properly completed and
        duly executed copy of IRS Form&#8239;W-9. Supplier shall be solely responsible for its own income Taxes with respect to amounts received in connection with this Agreement.</div>
      <div><br>
      </div>
      <div style="text-align: justify; text-indent: 72pt;">Section 3.03</div>
      <div style="margin: -12pt 0px 0px; text-align: justify; text-indent: 144pt;"><u>Right of Set-Off</u>. KBR shall pay the full amount of Service Charges and shall not set-off, counterclaim or otherwise withhold any amount owed to Supplier under this
        Agreement, on account of any obligation owed by KBR to Supplier or Supplier to KBR, as applicable, under this Agreement, the Separation Agreement or any other Ancillary Agreement that has not been finally adjudicated, settled or otherwise agreed
        upon by the Parties in writing.</div>
      <div><br>
      </div>
      <div style="text-align: center; font-weight: bold;">ARTICLE IV</div>
      <div><br>
      </div>
      <div style="text-align: center; font-weight: bold;">INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY RIGHTS</div>
      <div><br>
      </div>
      <div style="text-align: justify; text-indent: 72pt;">Section 4.01</div>
      <div style="margin: -12pt 0px 0px; text-align: justify; text-indent: 144pt;"><u>Ownership of Background IP</u>. All Intellectual Property belonging to a Party as of the Effective Date (whether developed by or on behalf of that Party or acquired by it
        from a third party) or developed or acquired by it independently (or on its behalf) from the performance of its obligations under this Agreement after the Effective Date shall remain vested in that Party.</div>
      <div><br>
      </div>
      <div style="text-align: justify; text-indent: 72pt;">Section 4.02</div>
      <div style="margin: -12pt 0px 0px; text-align: justify; text-indent: 144pt;"><u>Ownership of Foreground IP</u>. All Intellectual Property Rights developed in the course of the provision of the Services shall be solely owned by Supplier or the
        applicable Service Affiliate, except as otherwise agreed by the Parties in a Statement of Work solely with respect thereto, in which case all Intellectual Property resulting from such development shall be owned solely by the Recipient.</div>
      <div><br>
      </div>
      <div style="clear: both; margin-top: 10pt; margin-bottom: 10pt;" class="BRPFPageBreakArea">
        <div class="BRPFPageNumberArea" style="text-align: center;"><font class="BRPFPageNumber" style="font-weight: normal; font-style: normal;">9</font></div>
        <div style="page-break-after: always;" class="BRPFPageBreak">
          <hr style="margin: 4px 0px; width: 100%; border-width: 0; height: 2px; color: #000000; background-color: #000000; clear: both;" noshade="noshade"></div>
      </div>
      <div><br>
      </div>
      <div style="text-align: justify; text-indent: 72pt;">Section 4.03</div>
      <div style="margin: -12pt 0px 0px; text-align: justify; text-indent: 144pt;"><u>License by Supplier</u>. Supplier hereby grants and shall procure that each Service Affiliate shall grant, to KBR or the relevant Recipient and its Affiliates a
        royalty-free, non-exclusive, non-transferable (except as set out in <u>Section 9.06</u>), non-sub-licensable license during the Term to use the Intellectual Property controlled by Supplier and the applicable Service Affiliate only to the extent
        necessary for the Recipient&#8217;s receipt of the Services in accordance with this Agreement.</div>
      <div><br>
      </div>
      <div style="text-align: justify; text-indent: 72pt;">Section 4.04</div>
      <div style="margin: -12pt 0px 0px; text-align: justify; text-indent: 144pt;"><u>License by Recipient</u>. KBR hereby grants and shall procure that each Recipient shall grant, to Supplier and the applicable Service Affiliates, a royalty-free,
        non-exclusive, non-transferable (except as set out in <u>Section 9.06</u>), non-sub-licensable (except to subcontractors permitted under this Agreement) license during the Term to use the Intellectual Property controlled by the Recipient and its
        Affiliates only to the extent necessary for the provision of the Services by Supplier and any applicable Service Affiliates in accordance with this Agreement.</div>
      <div><br>
      </div>
      <div style="text-align: justify; text-indent: 72pt;">Section 4.05</div>
      <div style="margin: -12pt 0px 0px; text-align: justify; text-indent: 144pt;"><u>Definition of the term &#8220;control&#8221;</u>. For the purposes of <u>Section 4.03</u> and <u>Section 4.04</u>, the term &#8220;control&#8221; shall mean having the legal authority to grant
        the relevant license under the relevant Intellectual Property Right without violating the terms of any agreement with any third party and without triggering any additional payment obligations to such third party. If the grant of any such license
        requires a Required Consent, <u>Section 8.02</u> shall apply.</div>

        IN REGARD TO QUALITY, PERFORMANCE, NONINFRINGEMENT, MISAPPROPRIATION, COMMERCIAL UTILITY, OR MERCHANTABILITY OR FITNESS OF THE SERVICES AND FACILITIES FOR A PARTICULAR PURPOSE.</div>

        Services, as applicable, under this Agreement. FOR THE AVOIDANCE OF DOUBT AND NOTWITHSTANDING ANYTHING HEREIN TO THE CONTRARY, EACH PARTY EXPRESSLY DISCLAIMS ANY EXPRESS OR IMPLIED OBLIGATION OR WARRANTY WITH RESPECT TO THE SERVICES THAT COULD BE
        CONSTRUED TO REQUIRE SUPPLIER OR ANY SERVICE AFFILIATE TO DELIVER SERVICES HEREUNDER IN SUCH A MANNER TO ALLOW A RECIPIENT TO ITSELF COMPLY WITH ANY LAW APPLICABLE TO THE ACTIONS OR FUNCTIONS OF SUCH RECIPIENT (OR ITS AFFILIATES).</div>

        DAMAGES, LOSS OF DATA, LOSS OF USE OR LOST PROFITS, REVENUES OR OPPORTUNITIES OR LOST OR DELAYED GENERATION OR DIMINUTION IN VALUE OF ASSETS OR SECURITIES OR ANY LOSSES CALCULATED BASED ON A MULTIPLE OF REVENUES, EARNINGS OR OTHER ECONOMIC OR

        SERVICES OR ANY OTHER INFORMATION OR MATERIALS PROVIDED TO THE RECIPIENTS HEREUNDER, WHETHER IN CONTRACT, TORT (INCLUDING NEGLIGENCE AND STRICT LIABILITY) OR OTHERWISE, AND WHETHER OR NOT THE PARTY HAS BEEN ADVISED OF OR OTHERWISE MIGHT HAVE
        ANTICIPATED THE POSSIBILITY OF SUCH LOSSES.</div>

        connection with this Agreement, its termination, or expiration, whether in contract, tort or otherwise, be greater than an amount equal to the aggregate Service Charges paid or payable by KBR or any applicable Recipient under this Agreement in the
        twelve (12) months preceding the event giving rise to the claim. KBR acknowledges that the liability caps described in this <u>Section 5.03</u> are fair and reasonable.</div>

        Supplier hereby waives the right to seek recovery for such Indemnifiable Losses from or equitable remedies against any of KBR&#8217;s Affiliates and each of their respective past, present or future officers, directors, employees and agents and their
        respective successors, heirs and assignees and representatives.</div>

      <div style="text-align: justify; text-indent: 108pt;">(b)</div>

        must be based solely on the provisions of this Agreement.</div>

        any Recipient or its or their respective Indemnified Parties for: (i) any failure to perform the Services or any of its obligations hereunder in accordance with this Agreement; or (ii) any Indemnifiable Losses or inconveniences incurred by KBR or
        any Recipient or any of its Affiliates or its or their respective Indemnified Parties, in each case ((i) and (ii)) to the extent caused by, relating to, or arising out of or in connection with: (A) KBR or the applicable Recipient&#8217;s acts, omissions,
        or breach of this Agreement or failure to satisfy any of its obligations under this Agreement; (B) KBR&#8217;s or any Recipient&#8217;s implementation, execution, use or exploitation of any of the services (including the Services), products (including product
        liability claims) or other deliverables received by or benefits (including usage rights) granted to KBR or the applicable Recipient under or in accordance with this Agreement; (C) any transactions contemplated by this Agreement other than the
        provision of the Services or Supplier&#8217;s other express obligations set out in this Agreement; or (D) Supplier&#8217;s or the applicable Service Affiliate&#8217;s actions or inactions in connection with any deliverables, benefits or transactions pursuant to (A)
        through (D) or that were caused by specifications or directions provided by KBR or the applicable Recipient, except, in each case, to the extent caused by Supplier&#8217;s or the applicable Service Affiliate&#8217;s gross negligence or willful misconduct in
        performing any of its obligations pursuant to this Agreement.</div>

      <div style="margin: -12pt 0px 0px; text-align: justify; text-indent: 144pt;"><u>Indemnification by KBR</u>. KBR shall indemnify, defend, save and hold harmless Supplier and the Service Affiliates and any of their personnel, successors and assigns
        (collectively, the &#8220;Supplier <u>Indemnified Parties</u>&#8221;), from and against any and all Indemnifiable Losses to the extent resulting from or arising out of any Third Party Claim to the extent resulting from or arising out of: (a) any breach of <u>Section
          8.02(e)</u>; (b) any fraudulent, grossly negligent or willful acts or omissions by KBR or any Recipient; and (c) non-compliance with or breach of any InfoSec Policy of Supplier or an applicable Service Affiliate by KBR or the applicable Recipient
        or their respective personnel.</div>
      <div><br>
      </div>
      <div style="text-align: justify; text-indent: 72pt;">Section 6.02</div>
      <div style="margin: -12pt 0px 0px; text-align: justify; text-indent: 144pt;"><u>Indemnification by Supplier</u>. Supplier shall indemnify, defend, save and hold harmless KBR, the Recipients and any of their personnel, successors and assigns
        (collectively, the &#8220;Recipient Indemnified Parties&#8221; and, together with the Supplier Indemnified Parties, the &#8220;<u>Indemnified Parties</u>&#8221;), from and against any and all Indemnifiable Losses to the extent resulting from or arising out of any Third
        Party Claim to the extent resulting from or arising out of: (a) Supplier&#8217;s gross negligence or intentional misconduct in the provision of Services by Supplier hereunder; (b) non-compliance with or breach of any InfoSec Policy of KBR or the
        applicable Recipient by Supplier or its personnel; and (c) Supplier&#8217;s breach of the Data Processing Agreement.</div>
      <div><br>
      </div>
      <div style="text-align: justify; text-indent: 72pt;">Section 6.03</div>
      <div style="margin: -12pt 0px 0px; text-align: justify; text-indent: 144pt;"><u>Indemnification Procedures</u>. <u>Sections 5.4</u> and <u>5.5</u> of the Separation Agreement shall govern the rights and obligations of the Parties in respect of the
        management and conduct of any claims for indemnification under this Agreement.</div>

      <div style="text-align: center; font-weight: bold;">ARTICLE VII</div>
      <div><br>
      </div>
      <div style="text-align: center; font-weight: bold;"><u>TERMINATION</u></div>
      <div><br>
      </div>
      <div style="text-align: justify; text-indent: 72pt;">Section 7.01</div>
      <div style="margin: -12pt 0px 0px; text-align: justify; text-indent: 144pt;"><u>Termination</u>.</div>
      <div><br>
      </div>
      <div style="text-align: justify; text-indent: 108pt;">(a)</div>
      <div style="margin: -12pt 0px 0px; text-align: justify; text-indent: 144pt;">This Agreement may be terminated by Supplier upon notice to KBR: (i)&#8239;if KBR or any Recipient is in material breach of the terms of this Agreement and such breach is not
        corrected within thirty (30) days of a written notice from Supplier or the Supplier Relationship Manager of such breach; (ii) with respect to any Service, including access to any Facility, if the continued performance of such Service or the
        provision of access to the applicable Facility would be a violation of any Law or any Contract in effect prior to the Effective Date; (iii)&#8239;upon any failure of KBR to pay any outstanding Service Charge due to Supplier within ninety (90) days
        following the date on which such payment was due, except to the extent any part of an outstanding Service Charge is not paid due to a good faith dispute of such Service Charge by KBR; or (iv) if KBR undergoes a change of control, meaning that a
        third party acquires control over KBR or KBR has transferred or assigned this Agreement or any rights, interests or obligations hereunder in breach of <u>Section 9.06</u>.</div>
      <div><br>
      </div>
      <div style="text-align: justify; text-indent: 108pt;">(b)</div>
      <div style="margin: -12pt 0px 0px; text-align: justify; text-indent: 144pt;">This Agreement may be terminated earlier by KBR upon notice to Supplier&#8239;if Supplier or any Service Affiliate is in material breach of the terms of this Agreement and such
        breach is not corrected within thirty (30) days of a written notice from KBR or the KBR Relationship Manager of such breach.</div>
      <div><br>
      </div>
      <div style="clear: both; margin-top: 10pt; margin-bottom: 10pt;" class="BRPFPageBreakArea">

      <div style="margin: -12pt 0px 0px; text-align: justify; text-indent: 144pt;">Without prejudice to any rights with respect to a Force Majeure: (i) KBR may terminate this Agreement or any Statement of Work with respect to any Service or access to
        Facility, in whole or in part: (A) for any reason or no reason upon providing at least thirty (30) days&#8217; prior written notice to the Supplier Relationship Manager of such termination (unless a longer notice period is specified in the applicable
        Statement of Work or in a third party Contract to provide Services or access to Facilities); or (B)&#8239;if Supplier or the applicable Service Affiliate providing such Service or Facilities has failed to perform any of its material obligations under
        this Agreement with respect to such Service or access to Facility, and such failure shall continue to exist thirty (30) days after receipt by the Supplier Relationship Manager of written notice of such failure from the KBR Relationship Manager; and
        (ii) Supplier may terminate this Agreement or any Statement of Work with respect to one or more Services or access to Facilities, in whole or in part, at any time upon prior written notice to the KBR Relationship Manager if KBR or any applicable
        Recipient has failed to perform any of its material obligations under this Agreement relating to such Services or access to Facilities, and such failure shall be continued uncured for a period of thirty (30) days after receipt by the KBR
        Relationship Manager of a written notice of such failure from the Supplier Relationship Manager. The Service Charge associated with such Service or access to Facility shall be pro-rated appropriately, as applicable.</div>

      </div>
      <div style="text-align: justify; text-indent: 72pt;">Section 7.02</div>
      <div style="margin: -12pt 0px 0px; text-align: justify; text-indent: 144pt;"><u>Effect of Termination</u>.</div>
      <div><br>
      </div>
      <div style="text-align: justify; text-indent: 108pt;">(a)</div>
      <div style="margin: -12pt 0px 0px; text-align: justify; text-indent: 144pt;">Upon termination of any Service or access to any Facility pursuant to this Agreement, Supplier or the applicable Service Affiliate providing the terminated Service or access
        to the Facility or its Affiliate shall have no further obligation to provide the terminated Service or access to the Facility, and KBR shall have no obligation to pay any Service Charges relating to any such Service or access to such Facility; <font style="font-style: italic;"><u>provided</u></font> that KBR shall remain obligated to Supplier for the Service Charges owed and payable in respect of Services properly performed or access to Facilities provided prior to the effective date of
        termination. In connection with termination of any Service or access to any Facility, the provisions of this Agreement not relating solely to such terminated Service or access to such Facility shall survive any such termination.</div>
      <div><br>
      </div>
      <div style="text-align: justify; text-indent: 108pt;">(b)</div>
      <div style="margin: -12pt 0px 0px; text-align: justify; text-indent: 144pt;">Upon expiration or any termination of this Agreement:</div>
      <div><br>
      </div>
      <div style="text-align: justify; text-indent: 108pt; margin-left: 36pt;">(i)</div>
      <div style="margin: -12pt 0px 0px 36pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 144pt;">any licenses of Intellectual Property granted under ARTICLE IV shall terminate with immediate effect, except to the extent relevant to any remaining Services;</div>
      <div><br>
      </div>
      <div style="text-align: justify; text-indent: 108pt; margin-left: 36pt;">(ii)</div>
      <div style="margin: -12pt 0px 0px 36pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 144pt;">except to the extent required for the performance of its remaining obligations under this Agreement, each Party shall (and shall procure that its Affiliates shall)
        return or deliver to the other Party all records and documents containing Confidential Information of the other Party (or its Affiliates) shall destroy such Confidential Information, and certify that the destruction has taken place. The Party
        returning or destroying the Confidential Information may retain: (A) a copy of the Confidential Information for the purposes of, and so long as required by, any applicable Law or its internal compliance procedures; and (B) copies of any computer
        records and files containing any Confidential Information that have been created pursuant to automatic archiving and back-up procedures, subject to continuing obligations of non-use and non-disclosure; and</div>
      <div><br>
      </div>
      <div style="text-align: justify; text-indent: 108pt;">(c)</div>
      <div style="margin: -12pt 0px 0px; text-align: justify; text-indent: 144pt;">each Indemnifying Party&#8217;s obligations to provide indemnification to an Indemnified Party under ARTICLE VI will survive such expiration or termination and ARTICLE I, ARTICLE
        III, ARTICLE V, ARTICLE IX and this <u>Section 7.02 </u>and Liability for all due and unpaid Service Charges shall survive indefinitely.</div>

      <div style="text-align: justify; text-indent: 72pt;">Section 7.03</div>
      <div style="margin: -12pt 0px 0px; text-align: justify; text-indent: 144pt;"><u>Force Majeure</u>.</div>
      <div><br>
      </div>
      <div style="text-align: justify; text-indent: 108pt;">(a)</div>
      <div style="margin: -12pt 0px 0px; text-align: justify; text-indent: 144pt;">No Party (or any Person acting on its behalf) shall have any Liability or responsibility for failure to fulfill any obligation (other than a payment obligation) under this
        Agreement so long as and to the extent to which the fulfillment of such obligation is prevented, frustrated, hindered or delayed as a consequence of circumstances of Force Majeure; <font style="font-style: italic;"><u>provided</u></font> that:
        (i)&#8239;such Party (or such Person) shall have exercised commercially reasonable efforts to minimize the effect of Force Majeure on its obligations; and (ii)&#8239;the nature, quality and standard of care that Supplier or the applicable Service Affiliate
        shall provide in delivering a Service or providing access to a Facility after a Force Majeure shall be substantially the same as the nature, quality and standard of care that Supplier or the applicable Service Affiliate provides prior to the Force
        Majeure. In the event of an occurrence of a Force Majeure, the Party whose performance is affected thereby shall give notice of suspension as soon as reasonably practicable to the other stating the date and extent of such suspension and the cause
        thereof, and such Party shall resume the performance of such obligations as soon as reasonably practicable after the removal of the cause, and if Supplier or the applicable Service Affiliate is the Party so prevented then the Recipient shall not be
        obligated to pay the Service Charge for a Service or Facility to the extent and for so long as such Service has not been performed or such Facility is not made available to the Recipient hereunder as a result of such Force Majeure.</div>
      <div><br>
      </div>
      <div style="text-align: justify; text-indent: 108pt;">(b)</div>
      <div style="margin: -12pt 0px 0px; text-align: justify; text-indent: 144pt;">During the period of a Force Majeure, the Recipient shall be entitled to seek an alternative service provider at its own cost with respect to such Services or access to such
        Facilities. KBR shall be entitled to permanently terminate such Services or access to such Facilities (and shall be relieved of the obligation to pay Service Charges for the provision of such Services or access to such Facilities throughout the
        duration of such Force Majeure or, in the event of such permanent termination, thereafter) if a Force Majeure shall continue to exist for more than fifteen (15) consecutive days.</div>

      <div style="text-align: center; font-weight: bold;">ARTICLE VIII</div>
      <div><br>

      <div style="text-align: center; font-weight: bold;"><u>MANAGEMENT AND CONTROL</u></div>
      <div><br>
      </div>
      <div style="text-align: justify; text-indent: 72pt;">Section 8.01</div>
      <div style="margin: -12pt 0px 0px; text-align: justify; text-indent: 144pt;"><u>Cooperation</u>.</div>
      <div><br>
      </div>
      <div style="text-align: justify; text-indent: 108pt;">(a)</div>
      <div style="margin: -12pt 0px 0px; text-align: justify; text-indent: 144pt;">During the Term, KBR shall, and shall cause each Recipient to, use its commercially reasonable efforts to cooperate with Supplier and the relevant Service Affiliate and with
        respect to Supplier or such Service Affiliate providing the Services and access to the Facilities and responding to Supplier&#8217;s or such Service Affiliate reasonable requests for information related, as applicable, to the provision of the Services or
        operation of Facilities in connection therewith. KBR shall not and shall procure that its Affiliates shall not knowingly take any action which would substantially interfere with or substantially increase the cost of Supplier providing (or causing
        to be provided) any of the Services or access to the Facilities. KBR shall provide Supplier or the relevant Service Affiliate with reasonable access (during reasonable business hours) to KBR&#8217;s personnel and facilities for the purpose of training
        and consultation with respect to the Services and access to Facilities. If KBR or an applicable Recipient fails to perform such functions or contributions, Supplier and the applicable Service Affiliate shall have no obligation to provide the
        relevant Service and shall not be responsible for any Indemnifiable Losses resulting therefrom.</div>
      <div><br>
      </div>
      <div style="text-align: justify; text-indent: 108pt;">(b)</div>
      <div style="margin: -12pt 0px 0px; text-align: justify; text-indent: 144pt;">To the extent Supplier or any Service Affiliate has entered into any third party Contracts in connection with any of the Services or access to the Facilities, KBR shall and
        shall cause any applicable Recipients to comply with the terms of such Contract to the extent KBR or such Affiliate Recipients, as applicable, have been informed of such terms.</div>

      <div style="text-align: justify; text-indent: 72pt;">Section 8.02</div>
      <div style="margin: -12pt 0px 0px; text-align: justify; text-indent: 144pt;"><u>Required Consents</u>.</div>
      <div><br>
      </div>
      <div style="text-align: justify; text-indent: 108pt;">(a)</div>
      <div style="margin: -12pt 0px 0px; text-align: justify; text-indent: 144pt;">Each Party shall use commercially reasonable efforts to obtain any and all third party Consents necessary or advisable to allow the Supplier or the applicable Service
        Affiliate to provide the Services (the &#8220;<u>Required Consents</u>&#8221;); <font style="font-style: italic;"><u>provided</u>, <u>however</u></font>, that the costs of such third party Consents shall be paid by the Recipient of such Services. Each Party
        shall provide written evidence of receipt of Required Consents to the other Party upon such other Party&#8217;s request.</div>
      <div><br>
      </div>
      <div style="text-align: justify; text-indent: 108pt;">(b)</div>
      <div style="margin: -12pt 0px 0px; text-align: justify; text-indent: 144pt;">To the extent that Required Consents are only granted subject to conditions (including the condition of additional payments), Supplier or the applicable Service Affiliate
        shall coordinate with the applicable Recipient to determine whether such conditions shall be accepted. To the extent any Required Consent is not granted, or are revoked or terminated, Supplier or the applicable Service Affiliate shall cooperate
        with the applicable Recipient to determine a commercially reasonable alternative method of providing the relevant Service or to otherwise modify the affected Service.</div>
      <div><br>
      </div>
      <div style="text-align: justify; text-indent: 108pt;">(c)</div>
      <div style="margin: -12pt 0px 0px; text-align: justify; text-indent: 144pt;">All costs and expenses incurred by Supplier or the applicable Service Affiliate in obtaining any Required Consents or identifying, preparing or implementing any such
        alternative method, as applicable, shall be borne by the applicable Recipient. Supplier or the applicable Service Affiliate shall not be required to relinquish or forbear any rights in connection with obtaining any Required Consent.</div>
      <div><br>
      </div>
      <div style="text-align: justify; text-indent: 108pt;">(d)</div>
      <div style="margin: -12pt 0px 0px; text-align: justify; text-indent: 144pt;"><u>Section 8.02(a)</u>, <u>Section 8.02(b)</u> and <u>Section 8.02(c)</u> shall apply <font style="font-style: italic;">mutatis mutandis</font> where a Service in whole
        or in part is provided by a Third Party Provider as used at the Effective Date and Supplier&#8217;s or the applicable Service Affiliate&#8217;s contract with such Third Party Provider with respect to such Service expires or is terminated any time after the
        Effective Date by the applicable Third Party Provider for a reason other than Supplier&#8217;s or the applicable Service Affiliate&#8217;s breach of the agreement in place with such Third Party Provider.</div>
      <div><br>
      </div>
      <div style="text-align: justify; text-indent: 108pt;">(e)</div>
      <div style="margin: -12pt 0px 0px; text-align: justify; text-indent: 144pt;">KBR shall comply and shall cause each Recipient to comply with all obligations, including use restrictions and non-disclosure provisions, imposed on Supplier or the
        applicable Service Affiliate through any Third Party Contract or any Required Consent, provided that Supplier has notified KBR or KBR or the applicable Recipient is otherwise aware of such obligations.</div>
      <div><br>
      </div>
      <div style="text-align: justify; text-indent: 108pt;">(f)</div>
      <div style="margin: -12pt 0px 0px; text-align: justify; text-indent: 144pt;"><u>Section 8.02(a)</u>, <u>Section 8.02(b)</u> and <u>Section 8.02(c)</u> shall not apply in the situation where, following the Effective Date, Supplier or an applicable
        Service Affiliate elects to subcontract or outsource to a Third Party Provider the performance of a Service previously provided by Supplier&#8217;s or such applicable Service Affiliate&#8217;s own personnel or the personnel of a Service Affiliate.</div>
      <div><br>
      </div>
      <div style="clear: both; margin-top: 10pt; margin-bottom: 10pt;" class="BRPFPageBreakArea">
        <div class="BRPFPageNumberArea" style="text-align: center;"><font class="BRPFPageNumber" style="font-weight: normal; font-style: normal;">15</font></div>
        <div style="page-break-after: always;" class="BRPFPageBreak">
          <hr style="margin: 4px 0px; width: 100%; border-width: 0; height: 2px; color: #000000; background-color: #000000; clear: both;" noshade="noshade"></div>
      </div>
      <div><br>
      </div>
      <div style="text-align: justify; text-indent: 72pt;">Section 8.03</div>
      <div style="margin: -12pt 0px 0px; text-align: justify; text-indent: 144pt;"><u>Primary Points of Contact for Agreement</u>.</div>
      <div><br>
      </div>
      <div style="text-align: justify; text-indent: 108pt;">(a)</div>
      <div style="margin: -12pt 0px 0px; text-align: justify; text-indent: 144pt;"><u>Appointment and Responsibilities</u>. Each Party shall appoint an individual to act as the primary point of operational contact for the administration and operation of
        this Agreement, as follows:</div>
      <div><br>
      </div>
      <div style="text-align: justify; text-indent: 108pt; margin-left: 36pt;">(i)</div>
      <div style="margin: -12pt 0px 0px 36pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 144pt;">KBR shall appoint an individual as the primary point of operational contact pursuant to this <u>Section 8.03(a)</u>&#8239;(the &#8220;<u>KBR Relationship Manager</u>&#8221;), who shall
        initially be the Transition Manager of KBR under the Transition Services Agreement, and who shall have overall operational responsibility for coordinating, on behalf of KBR, all activities undertaken by KBR and its Recipients and its and their
        Affiliates hereunder, including the performance of KBR&#8217;s obligations hereunder, acting as a day-to-day contact with Supplier Relationship Manager and making available to the applicable Supplier Party the data, facilities, resources and other
        support services from KBR required for the applicable Supplier Party to be able to provide the Services in accordance with the requirements of this Agreement. KBR may change KBR Relationship Manager from time to time upon written notice to
        Supplier. KBR shall use commercially reasonable efforts to provide at least thirty (30) days&#8217; prior written notice of any such change.</div>
      <div><br>
      </div>
      <div style="text-align: justify; text-indent: 108pt; margin-left: 36pt;">(ii)</div>
      <div style="margin: -12pt 0px 0px 36pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 144pt;">Supplier shall appoint an individual as the primary point of operational contact pursuant to this <u>Section 8.03(a)</u> (the &#8220;<u>Supplier Relationship Manager</u>&#8221;
        and each of the KBR Relationship Manager and the Supplier Relationship Manager, a &#8220;<u>Relationship Manager</u>&#8221;), who shall initially be the Transition Manager of Supplier under the Transition Services Agreement, and who shall have overall
        operational responsibility for coordinating, on behalf of Supplier, all activities undertaken by Supplier and Service Affiliates hereunder, including the performance of Supplier&#8217;s obligations hereunder, the coordinating of the provision of the
        Services with KBR, acting as a day-to-day contact with the KBR Relationship Manager. Supplier may change the Supplier Relationship Manager from time to time upon written notice to KBR. Supplier shall use commercially reasonable efforts to provide
        at least thirty (30) days&#8217; prior written notice of any such change.</div>
      <div><br>
      </div>
      <div style="text-align: justify; text-indent: 108pt;">(b)</div>
      <div style="margin: -12pt 0px 0px; text-align: justify; text-indent: 144pt;"><u>Review Meetings</u>. The Supplier Relationship Manager and the KBR Relationship Manager shall meet either via telephone or video conference or as otherwise agreed between
        the Supplier Relationship Manager and the KBR Relationship Manager at least monthly to review Supplier&#8217;s provision of the Services as required under this Agreement.</div>
      <div><br>
      </div>
      <div style="text-align: justify; text-indent: 72pt;">Section 8.04</div>
      <div style="margin: -12pt 0px 0px; text-align: justify; text-indent: 144pt;"><u>Steering Committee</u>.</div>
      <div><br>
      </div>
      <div style="text-align: justify; text-indent: 108pt;">(a)</div>
      <div style="margin: -12pt 0px 0px; text-align: justify; text-indent: 144pt;"><u>Size and Composition</u>. The Steering Committee constituted in accordance with Section 8.04 of the Transition Services Agreement shall serve as the initial steering
        committee under this Agreement (the &#8220;<u>Steering Committee</u>&#8221;). Either Party may change its Steering Committee members from time to time upon written notice to the other Party; <font style="font-style: italic;"><u>provided</u>, <u>however</u></font>,
        that Supplier Relationship Manager and KBR Relationship Manager shall at all times remain as members of the Steering Committee. In addition, the Parties may mutually agree to increase or decrease the size, purpose or composition of the Steering
        Committee in an effort for Supplier and the Service Affiliates to better provide, and for the Recipients to better utilize, the Services. The Steering Committee shall disband automatically upon termination of this Agreement in accordance with its
        terms.</div>
      <div><br>
      </div>
      <div style="clear: both; margin-top: 10pt; margin-bottom: 10pt;" class="BRPFPageBreakArea">
        <div class="BRPFPageNumberArea" style="text-align: center;"><font class="BRPFPageNumber" style="font-weight: normal; font-style: normal;">16</font></div>
        <div style="page-break-after: always;" class="BRPFPageBreak">
          <hr style="margin: 4px 0px; width: 100%; border-width: 0; height: 2px; color: #000000; background-color: #000000; clear: both;" noshade="noshade"></div>
      </div>
      <div><br>
      </div>
      <div style="text-align: justify; text-indent: 108pt;">(b)</div>
      <div style="margin: -12pt 0px 0px; text-align: justify; text-indent: 144pt;"><u>Responsibilities</u>. The Steering Committee&#8217;s responsibilities include:</div>
      <div><br>
      </div>
      <div style="text-align: justify; text-indent: 108pt; margin-left: 36pt;">(i)</div>
      <div style="margin: -12pt 0px 0px 36pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 144pt;">generally overseeing the performance of each Party&#8217;s obligations under this Agreement; and</div>
      <div><br>
      </div>
      <div style="text-align: justify; text-indent: 108pt; margin-left: 36pt;">(ii)</div>
      <div style="margin: -12pt 0px 0px 36pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 144pt;">making, and providing continuity for making, decisions for the Recipients with respect to the establishment, prioritization and use of the Services and access to the
        Facilities.</div>
      <div><br>
      </div>
      <div style="text-align: justify; text-indent: 108pt;">(c)</div>
      <div style="margin: -12pt 0px 0px; text-align: justify; text-indent: 144pt;"><u>Meetings</u>. The Steering Committee shall meet once a month or with such other frequency as mutually agreed by the Parties. Each Steering Committee meeting shall be via
        telephone or video conference or as otherwise agreed by the members of the Steering Committee.</div>
      <div><br>
      </div>
      <div style="text-align: justify; text-indent: 72pt;">Section 8.05</div>
      <div style="margin: -12pt 0px 0px; text-align: justify; text-indent: 144pt;"><u>Personnel</u>.</div>
      <div><br>
      </div>
      <div style="text-align: justify; text-indent: 108pt;">(a)</div>
      <div style="margin: -12pt 0px 0px; text-align: justify; text-indent: 144pt;">Supplier or the Service Affiliate providing any Service shall make available to the Recipient of such Service such personnel as may be reasonably necessary to provide such
        Service, in accordance with Supplier&#8217;s or such Service Affiliate&#8217;s standard business practices. Supplier or the applicable Service Affiliate shall have the right, in its reasonable discretion, to: (i)&#8239;designate which personnel it will assign to
        perform such Service; and (ii)&#8239;remove and replace such personnel at any time.</div>
      <div><br>
      </div>
      <div style="text-align: justify; text-indent: 108pt;">(b)</div>
      <div style="margin: -12pt 0px 0px; text-align: justify; text-indent: 144pt;">Supplier or the Service Affiliate providing any Service shall be solely responsible for all salary, employment and other benefits of and Liabilities relating to the
        employment of persons employed by Supplier or such Service Affiliate. In performing their respective duties hereunder, all such employees and representatives of Supplier or any applicable Service Affiliate shall be under the direction, control and
        supervision of Supplier or such Service Affiliate, as applicable, and Supplier or such Service Affiliate shall have the sole right to exercise all authority with respect to the employment (including termination of employment), assignment and
        compensation of such employees and representatives.</div>
      <div><br>
      </div>
      <div style="text-align: justify; text-indent: 72pt;">Section 8.06</div>
      <div style="margin: -12pt 0px 0px; text-align: justify; text-indent: 144pt;"><u>No Agency</u>. Nothing in this Agreement shall be deemed in any way or for any purpose to constitute any Party or its Affiliates acting as an agent of another
        unaffiliated Person in the conduct of such other Person&#8217;s business. Supplier or the Service Affiliate providing any Service or access to any Facility hereunder shall act as an independent contractor and not as the agent of the Recipient or its
        Affiliates in performing such Service or providing access to such Facility.</div>
      <div><br>
      </div>
      <div style="text-align: justify; text-indent: 72pt;">Section 8.07</div>
      <div style="margin: -12pt 0px 0px; text-align: justify; text-indent: 144pt;"><u>Data Processing</u>. To the extent that the Services involve the processing of Personal Data by Supplier or any Service Affiliate, the provisions of the Data Processing
        Agreement by and between the Parties, dated as of the effective date of the Transition Services Agreement, shall govern such Processing.</div>
      <div><br>
      </div>
